description: HTW Berlin publishes L4R_NLB, 10,253 annotated rail-scene images from Norwegian broadcast footage of the Trondheim to Bodø route. Four seasonal journeys yielded 28,620 candidate frames; the released set contains the labelled subset with track lines, switch boxes and scene tags. Zenodo lists PNG images, JSON annotations, camera matrices and masks, with free access under CC BY 3.0. The data can train or validate railway perception components used in train-operation simulations. A limitation is coverage of one camera view along one route and four seasonal recordings, without a stated continuous measurement period. The source footage comes from NRK, so users should check its attribution and reuse terms alongside the deposit licence. Labels and camera calibration were not independently tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
